apks.help: There is no ready APK. Download VictoryHeatRallyVR-Quest-<version>.zip, extract it, close the game and run Install-Quest.bat on a Windows PC with the headset on USB. It patches your Steam copy of Victory Heat Rally, builds and signs VHRQuest.apk and installs it itself.

steps.text: Open VHR Quest from Library > Unknown Sources. To update, download the new release and run Install-Quest.bat again. Saves and settings stay on the headset.

notes: The release is a Windows installer zip, not an APK. Install-Quest.bat finds the Steam copy, downloads UndertaleModTool CLI, platform-tools and the OpenXR loader, patches the game data, builds and signs VHRQuest.apk and installs it over USB. If the game is not found, the user runs Install-Quest.ps1 -GameDirectory <folder>. The script installs the APK itself, so qgp's install-apk step is only needed if the user picks the built VHRQuest.apk; whether the script leaves that file on disk is not stated in the guide. Optional settings go in /sdcard/Android/data/com.segadreamcat.vhrquest/files/vhrq.txt.
